day♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:

celeb?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Rehearsal for walking the red carpet~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Even the race I'm running today connects 
all the way to Dubai! In that case—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You have to hold your head high in any 
race♪ Fitting for a celebrity, right? ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I am definitely, totally gonna win! 
Trainy, let's practice together afterward, 
okay? ♡
